d.ko: Take your brain for a walk in Handshakes, a simple yet tricksy sokoban puzzle game. Guide two hands through puzzles designed to stump, not frustrate, so that they may achieve their dream of a warm, firm handshake.
d.en: Take your brain for a walk in Handshakes, a simple yet tricksy sokoban puzzle game. Guide two hands through puzzles designed to stump, not frustrate, so that they may achieve their dream of a warm, firm handshake.
d.zh: 如同跟你的大脑散步，Handshakes是一个简单并且有技巧的推箱子解密游戏。来引导两只手，让它们实现一个有温暖又坚定的握手的梦想。
